text.p: Close of play scores on the third day of four-day Sheffield Shield matches on Sunday:
Brisbane: Victoria 162 (Andrew Bichel 5-46) and 268 for nine (Warren Ayres 56, Brad Hodge 51). Queensland 305 (Andrew Symonds 77).
Hobart: New South Wales 403 for nine declared (Brad McNamara 137 not out) and 70 for two. Tasmania 327 for nine declared (Shaun Young 108 not out, Michael DiVenuto 50).
Adelaide: South Australia 277 and 325 for nine (James Brayshaw 96, Geoff Parker 80 not out). Western Australia 318 (Justin Langer 116, Damien Martyn 96).
